en: Small bubbles rise through the glass of carbonated water.

prompt:
Subject: carbonated, 炭酸を含む. One complete drinking glass filled with pale blue carbonated water and many small bubbles rising inside. Draw glass as SOLID PALE BLUE FILLED shape with fully closed thick dark brown outer contour and thin flat white highlight INSIDE. Top opening ellipse also FILLED pale blue, NOT transparent hole. No white edges touching transparent background. No spilling, spray, splashes, ground or text. Crisp clean flat cartoon.
Use attached invidious.png for drawing style only: thick rounded dark brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D forms. All silhouettes clean closed dark brown outlines. 512x512 PNG RGBA.
